paragraphs: Rabbi Chunya of Chavran. R. Abba bar Zavda said: R. Chunya of Chavran ruled—beginning of chapter 9 of Sheviit; and Jerusalem Talmud, beginning of Lulav VaAravah, in the name of R. Chunya of Chavran. When R. Chanina of the house of Chavran went up to Jerusalem to intercalate years, the sea would split before him. When he died, the Sea of Tiberias split: Jerusalem Talmud, beginning of Kol HaTzelamim. R. Berekhiah and R. Yaakov bar Bat Yaakov, in his name: Maaser Sheni, chapter 5, halakhah 1; Shekalim, chapter 1, halakhah 1; Moed Katan, chapter 1, halakhah 2. R. Yosah, R. Yaakov bar Acha, Rabbi Chizkiyah, and Rabbi Uzziel son of R. Chunyai of the house of Chavran, in the name of R. Chunya of the house of Chavran; there.
